-- A future evaluator should assert the tasks table remains readable.
SELECT id, title, status FROM tasks LIMIT 0;

answer.summary: Added a non-null `status` column with a safe default of 'pending' to the offline schema snapshot in schema/current.sql, and updated the contract query in checks/schema_contract.sql to select the new status column. No migration was created and no database state was mutated; the offline check remains disposable.

argv: import sqlite3,pathlib; db=sqlite3.connect(":memory:"); db.executescript(pathlib.Path("schema/current.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")); db.executescript(pathlib.Path("checks/schema_contract.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")); assert db.execute("SELECT id,title,status FROM tasks").fetchall() == []; assert db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)").fetchall() == [(0, "id", "INTEGER", 0, None, 1), (1, "title", "TEXT", 1, None, 0), (2, "status", "TEXT", 1, "'pending'", 0)]
